entities.name: CLI
entities.rationale: Single-user icon labeled 'CLI' at upper left; an actor using a command-line interface that sends requests to the upper-left EC2. Not inside any container.

entities.name: Users
entities.rationale: Multi-user group icon at lower left (label partly hidden by presenter); arrow goes to the bottom EC2. Not inside any container.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Blue database icon labeled 'DYNAMO DB' at top center; receives an arrow from the left EC2. Left of the green vertical divider.

entities.name: EC2 (left, API/frontend)
entities.rationale: Orange EC2 icon labeled 'EC2' at middle left (775,428); receives from CLI, writes to DynamoDB and sends to SQS. Left of the green vertical divider.

entities.name: SQS
entities.rationale: Pink queue icon labeled 'SQS' at center (957,424), between the two EC2 icons; both EC2 arrows point at it. Left of the green vertical divider.

entities.name: EC2 (right, worker)
entities.rationale: Orange EC2 icon labeled 'EC2' at middle right (1133,419); arrow toward SQS (polling the queue) and a curved arrow to Lambda. Left of the green vertical divider.

entities.name: EC2 (bottom)
entities.rationale: Orange EC2 icon labeled 'EC2' at bottom center (978,673); receives from the users group and sends an arrow to Lambda. Left of the green vertical divider.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Orange Lambda icon labeled 'LAMBDA' at right (1367,660), on the right side of the green vertical line that separates it from the rest of the diagram; receives arrows from the right EC2 and the bottom EC2.

visual_connections.description: Blue curved arrow from the CLI user icon down to the left EC2.
Blue curved arrow from the left EC2 up to DynamoDB.
Short blue arrow from the left EC2 pointing right into SQS.
Short blue arrow from the right EC2 pointing left into SQS (arrowhead on the SQS side).
Blue curved arrow from the right EC2 crossing the green vertical line down to Lambda.
Blue arrow from the users group icon to the bottom EC2.
Blue arrow from the bottom EC2 crossing the green vertical line to Lambda.
